prs.title: fix(react-aria-components): inherit CheckboxGroup validationBehavior (#10856)
prs.author: mangeshraut712
prs.body:
## Summary
Inside a `CheckboxGroup`, `useCheckboxAria` was defaulting `validationBehavior` to `'native'`. That overrode a group-level setting such as `validationBehavior="aria"`, because `useCheckboxGroupItem` only inherits the group's value when the checkbox leaves `validationBehavior` undefined.

## Fix
When checkbox group state is present, leave `validationBehavior` undefined unless the checkbox (or form context) sets it explicitly, so the group setting is inherited.

## Test plan
- [x] Added regression: group `validationBehavior="aria"` + `isRequired` → checkbox has no `required` attr and `form.checkValidity()` is true
- [x] Existing CheckboxGroup validation tests still pass

Fixes #10856
